question: Find the ratio between the third proportional of 12 and 42 with the third proportional of 16 and 56.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The third proportional of numbers a and b is b² / a.

Required Ratio = (b₁² / a₁) : (b₂² / a₂)

Required Ratio = (42² / 12) : (56² / 16)

Required Ratio = (42 / 56)² × (16 / 12) = (3 / 4)² × (4 / 3)

Required Ratio = (9 / 16) × (4 / 3) = 3 / 4 = 3 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 4.**
